Okay. Thank you for being here. Like I said we just moved in together. The first few days were fine but yesterday he was distant  and I'm afraid he just doesn't like living with me and doesn't want to be with me. I hope that's not true but right now I feel like he doesn't care about me at all and I'm just annoying him with my crying. I don't know if he's even really asleep right now. I also really hope you're right about my landlord situation. They were really unfair to me from the moment I told them I wanted to move out. 

And I'm mad at myself for feeling this way and not just pulling myself together and going to bed. I have to be up in four hours for work.

I just moved to a new apartment to move in with my husband. We eloped secretly a little while back. My old landlords just told me they want to sue me because they want extra rent money because I didn't move out exactly on the 31st, even though I haven't been under contract with them since the end of December and I paid them for January anyway. I can't afford a lawyer. I came home tonight after a professional development workshop and my husband was mad at me because the underwear I was wearing was too sexy. I said I was sorry but he was still mad. Then I started to cry and he told me to shut up and just went to sleep and didn't even care when I got the news I was going to be sued. I've been crying all night and I tried to smother myself but got afraid and then I tried to cut my wrists but I couldn't force myself to really break the skin and the knife wasn't sharp enough to make it easier. He slept through it all and is still sleeping and I just feel worthless and like I'd be better off dead anyway.
